newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks seen down, awaiting economic data.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks seen down, awaiting economic data.

text.p: Thai stocks were expected to decline on Wednesday on investors disappointment with first quarter earnings of finance firms, brokers said.

"The index is expected to fall today as investors are not happy with first quarter earnings of finance companies. The market is also expected to remain bearish as investors would stay on the sidelines waiting for the country's key economic indicators to be released by the central bank on Thursday," Thaneit Khantigaroon of Ekachart Finance said.
The SET index fell 3.05 points to 691.16 on 2.5 billion baht turnover on Wednesday. -- Suthep Chawla (662) 652-0642
